==Description== <!--T:8-->

<!--T:3-->
The '''Std RecentFiles''' menu option displays a list of recent files which can be opened.

==Usage== <!--T:9-->

<!--T:5-->
# Select the {{MenuCommand|File → Open Recent}} option from the menu to display the recent files list.
# Select a file from the list to open it.

==Options== <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
* Press {{KEY|Esc}} twice or click outside the menu to close it.

==Preferences== <!--T:13-->

<!--T:15-->
See also: [[Preferences_Editor|Preferences Editor]].

<!--T:6-->
* The maximum number of files in the list is determined by the {{MenuCommand|Edit → Preferences → General → General → Size of recent file list}} preference.
